---
title: "Lossless supplementary archive partitioning"
format: html
---

Repackage the verified archive without recalculating or reformatting any values.
Large TSVs are divided at logical CSV-record boundaries, each with its original
header. Joining the data records in part order reproduces the original bytes.

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import csv, hashlib, io, json, sys, zipfile
src=Path('/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569/derived/supplementary_source_data_2026-09-22-v3/supplementary-source-data-review.zip')
out=Path(sys.argv[1]); assert not out.exists(); out.mkdir(parents=True)
limit=45_000_000
manifest=[]; pending=[]; estimated=0; part_number=0
def flush():
    global pending,estimated,part_number
    if not pending:return
    part_number+=1
    p=out/f'supplementary-data-part-{part_number:02d}.zip'
    with zipfile.ZipFile(p,'w',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED,compresslevel=6) as z:
        for name,b in pending:z.writestr(name,b)
    assert p.stat().st_size<limit,(p,p.stat().st_size)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(p) as z:
        assert z.testzip() is None
        for name,b in pending:
            digest=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
            assert hashlib.sha256(z.read(name)).hexdigest()==digest
            manifest.append(dict(zip=p.name,member=name,bytes=len(b),sha256=digest))
    pending=[];estimated=0
def push(name,b):
    global estimated
    import zlib
    size=len(zlib.compress(b,6))+len(name)*2+256
    assert size<limit,(name,size)
    if estimated+size>limit-100_000:flush()
    pending.append((name,b));estimated+=size
class RawRecords:
    def __init__(self,b):self.stream=io.BytesIO(b);self.consumed=[]
    def __iter__(self):return self
    def __next__(self):
        b=self.stream.readline()
        if not b:raise StopIteration
        self.consumed.append(b);return b.decode('utf-8')
    def take(self):
        b=b''.join(self.consumed);self.consumed=[];return b
splits=[]
with zipfile.ZipFile(src) as z:
    assert z.testzip() is None
    for info in z.infolist():
        b=z.read(info.filename)
        if info.compress_size<limit-100_000:
            push(info.filename,b);continue
        assert info.filename.endswith('.tsv'),info.filename
        raw=RawRecords(b);reader=csv.reader(raw,delimiter='\t')
        next(reader);header=raw.take(); chunks=[];acc=[];count=0;size=0
        for row in reader:
            record=raw.take()
            if size+len(record)>100_000_000 and acc:
                chunks.append((b''.join(acc),count));acc=[];size=0;count=0
            acc.append(record);size+=len(record);count+=1
        if acc:chunks.append((b''.join(acc),count))
        assert header+b''.join(c[0] for c in chunks)==b
        names=[]
        for i,(data,n) in enumerate(chunks,1):
            name=info.filename[:-4]+f'.part-{i:02d}.tsv'
            names.append(dict(member=name,rows=n));push(name,header+data)
        splits.append(dict(original_member=info.filename,original_sha256=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),header_bytes=len(header),parts=names,exact_reconstruction_verified=True))
flush()
# Independently reconstruct from finished ZIPs, not in-memory pre-export chunks.
locations={r['member']:r['zip'] for r in manifest}
for split in splits:
    digest=hashlib.sha256()
    for i,part in enumerate(split['parts']):
        with zipfile.ZipFile(out/locations[part['member']]) as z:blob=z.read(part['member'])
        digest.update(blob if i==0 else blob[split['header_bytes']:])
    assert digest.hexdigest()==split['original_sha256']
checks=dict(source_archive_sha256=hashlib.sha256(src.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),source_files=135,
            zip_files=part_number,max_zip_bytes=max(p.stat().st_size for p in out.glob('*.zip')),
            every_exported_member_verified=True,split_reconstruction_verified=True,
            splits=splits,members=manifest)
(out/'UPLOAD_MANIFEST.json').write_text(json.dumps(checks,indent=2))
(out/'README.md').write_text('# Supplementary data upload parts\n\nAll ZIP files are below 45,000,000 bytes. Upload together; each opens independently. These are lossless partitions of the reviewed source-data archive, not new analyses.\n\nThe large interaction-coefficient table is split into numbered TSV parts, each with its original header. Read them in numeric order and concatenate data rows (retain one header). Exported parts reconstruct the original SHA256 exactly. Other source files are unchanged. UPLOAD_MANIFEST.json maps each file to its ZIP and records hashes.\n\nScientific review status remains unchanged: column definitions, software provenance and final manuscript citations still need completion.\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in checks.items() if k not in ('members','splits')},indent=2))
```
